events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: The legend that is John Cleese is 87 today. From the Ministry of Silly Walks to Basil Fawlty, he’s given us some of the most memorable moments in British comedy history.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: White Album classic
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped an absolute masterpiece: 'The White Album'. Double disc, no title, just pure, unadulterated genius. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's legacy
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy with Queen continues to inspire and entertain. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul classic
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that really showed their evolution. Which track takes you back?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace still resonate deeply. His impact is immeasurable.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's legacy
angles.copy: Thinking of the one and only David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself and pushed boundaries. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to The King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still moves generations. Long live rock and roll!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar wizard
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The man behind some of the most iconic riffs in rock history. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's birthday
angles.copy: The legendary Rod Stewart is 82 today! From Faces to solo superstardom, he's given us decades of incredible music. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs from Madness
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! The voice of a generation, still bringing the house down. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's hits
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Love of the Common People', his voice defined the 80s for many. What's your favourite?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, businesswoman, and philanthropist Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's big day
angles.copy: The one, the only, Dolly Parton turns 81 today! A true icon who has given us so much joy and so many incredible songs. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and successful solo artist Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop heartthrob to songwriting legend, he's done it all. What's your favourite Gary-penned track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When the Going Gets Tough', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean celebration
angles.copy: Get out the party poppers! The fantastic Billy Ocean turns 77 today. His timeless tunes still get us dancing. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, rock and roll history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Imagine being there! Who would you have inducted first?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! From Take That to his solo ventures, he's always brought a unique energy. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop concert magic
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an incredible way to go out! Imagine being one of those lucky Londoners looking up.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Iconic British singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the drumming legend and hitmaker, Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your top track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's birthday
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back since '81! Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, known for his iconic roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! The national treasure Sir David Jason is 87 today. From Peckham to Poplar, he's given us some of the most cherished characters on British telly. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died,' when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering music legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, rock and roll lost three of its brightest stars in 'The Day The Music Died'. Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper – gone too soon, never forgotten.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer Rick Astley, famous for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rickrolling birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on wishing Rick Astley a very happy 61st birthday! The man, the legend, the voice. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love for Marley
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of love, peace, and unity through music is as powerful as ever. One love.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her seminal album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King's songwriting
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius who has penned some of the most timeless tunes in music history. What's your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable vocal legend Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Whitney's voice
angles.copy: 15 years ago today, we lost one of the most powerful voices of all time. Whitney Houston's music continues to resonate and inspire. Her legacy lives on.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their split, devastating fans across the nation.

angles.name: Take That's big news
angles.copy: Remember where you were? 31 years ago today, the news broke that Take That were splitting up. A moment that truly shook the pop world. Thankfully, they came back!
